kinds.order: the plan or pass bar was not shown to precede the data
kinds.control: an arm, threshold or harness gives the favoured method information or tuning the comparison lacks
kinds.sentence: a sentence disagrees with the committed data or code
kinds.missing: a claim has no committed output, the code does not run, or the test was never made
kinds.host: the result changes with the machine or cannot be replayed elsewhere
kinds.scope: a proof, certificate or checker covers less than the sentence that cites it
kinds.program: a defect in a program or instrument
kinds.packaging: a file, command or process step is wrong or absent
